home.title: INSPECT
home.content: INSPECT is a platform for monitoring and analyzing multiple types of calls and designed to provide deep visibility into the interactions between different components of a distributed system. INSPECT allows you to monitor and analyze the performance of your application, identify potential issues, and optimize your system's performance.

profiles.title: Who is INSPECT for ?
profiles.description: At first look, you might think that INSPECT is a developer tool only. But its value comes from the fact that every profile can use it. Developers are indeed the ones that have to implement it in the code. But after the implementation, everyone will find their work easier by using it.

technical.title: Technical profiles
technical.content: Technical profiles can check the health of microservices, if the deployment has errors. INSPECT can also be used for log analysis, to find the root cause of an issue. Many protocols are unified to avoid a long search in multiple log files.

functional.title: Functional profiles
functional.content: A functional profile might be able to find out easily what is wrong without asking the dev team to check for logs because INSPECT provides detailed informations. It is also possible to see which requests are the most used and which are the most critical, helping to prioritize the backlog.

observability.title: Observability
observability.content: INSPECT is a tool that can facilitate the observability of your application. It allows you to detect and diagnose problems in complex systems. You have optimal observability on your application.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.content: INSPECT allows you to extract useful insights from the collected data. This helps understand trends, identify queries more effectively, and improve system performance.

time.title: Real time
time.content: INSPECT allows you to follow in real time the api calls and the global performances. It helps for detecting quickly some issues and to resolve them before your users are getting impacted from it

e2e.title: Start to end informations
e2e.content: When you are trying to find the root cause of an issue, you might be used to look for one log in a lot of files and lines. INSPECT makes you improve time because it's able to follow an action to it's start until it's end, even if the trace id are changing.

uniformize.title: Data Uniformization
uniformize.content: Request analyzed are uniformized at a maximum level. If the callback are HTTP requests, JDBC, SMTP... the responses are studied so you can understand easily where the issue is located, even without any technical knowledge.

heartbeat.title: Monitoring
heartbeat.content: With INSPECT, you can watch and monitor all microservices of your project, know when was the last restart, what is the deployed version, the number of restarts, all of it in a few seconds.

installation.title: Installation
installation.content: To install INSPECT, there are 2 dependencies to add to your project: inspect-core and inspect-ng-collector

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.content: INSPECT is composed of 3 main components: the collector, the server and the application. The collector is responsible for collecting data from various sources, such as logs, metrics, and traces. The server is responsible for processing and storing the collected data, and providing a user interface for visualizing and analyzing the data. The application is responsible for generating the data that is collected by the collector.

application.title: Application
application.content: The application is the component that generates the data collected by the collector. It can be a web application, a backend service, or any other type of application that produces performance and tracking data.

collector.title: Collector
collector.content: The collector is the component responsible for collecting data from various sources. It can collect data from logs, metrics, and traces, and send them to the server for processing and storage.

server.title: Server
server.content: The server is the component responsible for processing and storing the data collected by the collector. It also provides a user interface for visualizing and analyzing the collected data, allowing users to understand the performance and behavior of their application.

components.title: Technical components
components.content: INSPECT is composed of several technical components that work together to provide a comprehensive monitoring and analysis solution. These components include the collector, server, and application, as well as various libraries and tools that facilitate data collection, processing, and visualization.
